rungs.title: Junior Designer
rungs.summary: Learning the brand, the design system and the tools.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the brand and the tools well enough to follow the system.
rungs.delivery: Produces assets from a clear brief, with review before anything ships.
rungs.leadership: Asks for feedback early and keeps their lead informed.

rungs.title: Designer
rungs.summary: Delivers designs end to end with light review.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in the design system, the tools and the HTML and CSS that carry a design.
rungs.delivery: Takes a brief to a finished, on-brand design with light review.
rungs.leadership: Presents their reasoning and takes feedback without defensiveness.

rungs.title: Senior Designer
rungs.summary: Sets direction for a project and mentors others.
rungs.knowledge: Deep craft plus AI image tooling; can defend choices from the brand down to the pixel.
rungs.delivery: Sets the direction for a project and delivers it consistently.
rungs.leadership: Mentors, runs critiques and builds trust with the people who commission the work.

rungs.title: Design Lead
rungs.summary: Owns the design practice and its quality.
rungs.knowledge: Owns the design system and understands delivery and people management.
rungs.delivery: Owns the quality of everything the practice ships.
rungs.leadership: Leads projects and people; represents design in company decisions.
